# agenco_geo_fence (Resource)

Manages the country list of an application's geo-fence. One geo-fence exists per application; whether the list allows or blocks is set by agenco_geo_fence_config.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "agenco_geo_fence" "eu_only" {
  application_id = agenco_application.storefront.id
  countries      = ["DE", "FR", "NL", "IE", "ES", "IT"]
  description    = "EU-only access"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Application this geo-fence applies to.
- `countries` (Set of String) Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description, up to 255 characters. Not returned by the API, so the configured value is kept in state.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Geo-fence ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import agenco_geo_fence.eu_only 0a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-ef0123456789
```
